With reference to the communication received regarding significant movement in price of the securities of the company, we wish to submit that the company is in compliance with the provisions of regulations 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.

The company has made all necessary disclosures to stock ex

The Exchange has sought clarification from Abril Paper Tech Ltd on November 3, 2026 with reference to significant movement in price, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded.
